# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Almost fourteen at the start of the school year [v01:c15:p0024]; roughly sixteen by the time he graduates to the fifth class [v01:c17:p0037, v01:c25:p0061].  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Student; later an elementary/district school teacher at Pale Sands  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall youth possessing wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown (or hazel) eyes, and a mouth contorted into a mocking grin. He is described by Isolde as 'terribly handsome'. As he matures through his studies, he grows remarkably tall, slim, and manly.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050)_

## Personality

Hugh is a high-spirited, intelligent, and confident boy with a penchant for teasing and mischievous pranks, such as pinning classmate's hair to chairs or teasing girls about their freckles. Despite his teasing, he possesses a strong sense of honor and chivalry, willingly taking responsibility for disturbances he causes to spare others from unfair punishment. He is competitive, driven, and academically ambitious, determined to top his class and excel in his studies.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## Traits

- Teasing and mischievous  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>

- Competitively ambitious  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

## Abilities

- Academic excellence in spelling, math, and general studies  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

## Goals

- To lead his class academically and excel in school  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
- To earn Nell Harcourt's forgiveness and friendship  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>

## History

After spending several years out west in Alberta due to his father's health, Hugh Carrow returns to Brierley to resume his schooling under Mr. Pidgeon. Upon returning from a summer in New Brunswick, he joins the fourth book class and quickly becomes the top student. He gets into trouble with Nell Harcourt when he pulls her braid and calls her 'Carrots', leading her to break her slate over his head. Though he attempts to apologize, Nell holds a grudge against him. During the term, he is forced to sit beside Nell as a punishment after a group tardiness incident, where he tries to offer her a sweethearts' candy, which she crushes underfoot. Despite Nell's hostility, Hugh competes vigorously with her for academic honors, eventually advancing alongside her to the fifth class and studying advanced branches like Latin and geometry. Later, he performs a recitation of 'Bingen on the Rhine' at the Brierley Debating Club concert, during which he retrieves a rose dropped by Nell. After finishing his studies at Brierley, he resigns his application for the Brierley school so Nell can have the teaching position, accepting a job at Pale Sands instead. He eventually encounters Nell on her way back from the cemetery and begs for her forgiveness, which she grants, leading to a close friendship between them.

## Background by volume

- Spent three years living in Alberta with his father while the latter was ill  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Visited cousins in New Brunswick over the summer before starting the term at Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
